Ahh, Project: Playtime, look at what we become...

So, as honor of it life span from 2022-2026, i would like to write my final review.
I joined after a few years after Forsaken and i have watched this game ROT. Its not funny sad, its just sad.
I give credit to mob that its there first time making a multiplayer game but what a mess was it at launch.
It was just mostly bugs that caused the problem but other that this game was...Fun!

Then Forsaken released .
I don't know what mob was thinking about the changes but GOD DANG this was DOG WATER.
Here are the major ones:
1-Got rid of private lobby's, so you could no longer play with a group of friends. 
2-Got rid of lobby hub
3-XP/Ticket bug (still not fixed) 
4-Got rid of Survivor and Monster tutorial (Why?)
5-Match Making from 2 different contents
6-Got rid of the Huggy pit (downed Survivor have nothing to do)

8-Bugged screen
9-Hit registration
10-Just being Survivor sided
11-No voice chat
12-Paying emotes blending the Monster in
13-Got Rid of Grapple hooks on walls (this one make sence tbh)
14-Boxy just being weak (Look how they massacered my boy!)
15-Claw/Think fast puzzle ping/ hit registration
16-Monster just leaving when all parts are deposited
17-Bugs, Vis glich's, framerates, and overall bad performance.
18-Lack of dev support
19-No major updates scenes 2023  :(

That's all i could think of right now, but still, that's not a good look for a game made by a big studio.
So why, why am i giving that a good review?

citations.review_text:
Completely and totally abandoned by the developers. 

I loved this game when it first came out, bugs and all. Phase 1 was good, but phase 2 was amazing. I loved the gameplay loop and felt like I was rewarded for playing. Then phase 3. Oh god phase 3. They purposefully took every good mechanic out behind the shed. It was completely unrecognizable, a shell of it's former self. 
Me and many other veteran players felt insulted, and left. No vets, no players. No players, no matches. One by one people trickled away. Exactly as MOB intended. 

Just a few minutes ago, they put out a post officially discontinuing support for the game entirely. They finally broke their silence after Three. Entire. Years. 
I was an active member of an unofficial Project Playtime Discord (No official one existed) where I would hear stories of people asking about PJPT in the official Poppy server, only to either get radio silence or "We're working on it". All requests for updates were ignored, I remember watching people get banned or kicked from the main server because they simply asked about the game. MOB was trying to silence and hide the game, despite the fact they still had paying customers playing it. 

I want my money back, MOB. You failed as developers and as a company. Be ashamed.

This game was really fun when it came out poppy playtime has a great cast of monsters but unfortunately they didnt use them to their full potential. I would have loved to see a new monster every phase or every 2 phases but its been the same 3 since the games launch. I used to play this all the time with my friends but now we hardly mention it cause it feels like the creators forgot about it. I booted it up after a few years just to be very disappointed  with what i have seen absolutely ZERO new content has been added since I last played and now I can hardly find a lobby.

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the game as shutting down or being abandoned by the developers after years without updates.

citations.review_text: This game has always held and always will have a special place in my heart. Originally released to keep the fans that were waiting for chapter 3 busy with another game, Mob Entertainment crafted the perfect survival/horror game that could attract new players with its charming mechanics and still be entertaining after tens of hours due to the high skill ceiling. The community was very wholesome, and I had a blast during the summer of 2023 with my friends. Finally, the game now finds its end and a really painful one. Mob really left the community in the dark for over 2 years, didn't even give hints and showed no sign of transparency. They really had a golden blueprint of a game in front of them and ignored it after the horrific release of Phase 3. Until now, the loyal fans have suggested so many ideas in order to bring back its prime or make it even playable and even then: no news and absolute silence. It's really sad to see it vegetate and fade away now after making fantastic memories and I thoroughly hope this transparency issue doesn't reoccur in the next project.

Ghosted for 3 whole years by the devs, only to get backstabbed and be told it's being shut down after years of false promises, honestly I wouldn't trust them with their new multiplayer game if THIS is how they treated this playerbase.

I love this game but I cannot in good conscience recommend it. It used to be really fun, but then the devs made a horrible update before abandoning the project. If they return I will definitely update my review but until then the only reason to play this is because it's free.
